question: In a certain code language, 'GRATEFUL' is coded as '209267562112', 'INSTANCE' is coded as '18138711435'. What is the code for 'LIKEWISE' in that code language?
solution:

The logic followed here is:

'GRATEFUL' is coded as '209267562112',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f667574a8186d615a7f3aff998d4b4d6389e65018b1e235f199b34f58165ea.png] 

'INSTANCE' is coded as '18138711435',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3b3f29346d02d5cc0554942f8532d900edc5f8ae4c4bc63e4a44bf1e2f6c645.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36e70f0f5a47c9cf9fd7c7939201cd0b6bc0440c7647374a7f90b2330b48d257.png]
